name: Lesson 3 What shall I do to be great?
definition: 学习用一般将来时表达未来的理想与计划，谈论如何向伟大人物学习。
key_points: 核心词汇：dream, future, scientist, study harder, read more, work hard, kind, brave, help others, give up, try my best, in the future
核心句型：I want to be ... like ... / In the future, I will ... / I should be good at ... / I will never give up my dream / What will you do then? / I will try my best
语法点：一般将来时 will + 动词原形表打算；want to be / want to do 表愿望；情态动词 should 表应该
common_mistakes: will 后加动词原形误加 -s 或 -ed
want to be 后接职业名词而非形容词
in the future 与 in the future of 混用
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
